item.title: Taylor Swift, The Beatles, Elvis & More Artists With the Most Weeks at No. 1 on the Billboard 200: Full List
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: "Welcome to this week's music update. We're talking chart-topping artists and the latest from Billboard. Let's dive in."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Drake is making headlines again, holding the number one spot on the Billboard 200 with his album 'Iceman'. This marks his 39th week at number one, extending his lead as the hip-hop artist with the most weeks at number one. He's also the Canadian artist with the most weeks at number one, and he's now tied with the one and only Elton John, who achieved 39 weeks at number one from 1972 to 1975."
[Short music transition]
Host: "It's worth noting that Elton John's span of number one albums may have been relatively short, but his impact on pop music spans over half a century. He was inducted into the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame in 1994. Will Drake follow in his footsteps? Only time will tell."
[Short music transition]
Host: "Drake's number one albums have spanned nearly 16 years, from July 2010 to June 2026. And if you're wondering where other iconic artists stand, Elvis Presley's entire career is captured on the Billboard 200, and the Bee Gees had an impressive run, especially with the Saturday Night Fever soundtrack."
[Outro music plays]
Host: "That's all for this week. Thanks for tuning in. We'll be back with more music news and updates soon."
[Outro music continues to play]
